title: FLARE++: Low-rank attention with dynamic attention routing
abstract: arXiv:2608.11519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Full self-attention is a strong token mixer for PDE surrogates on irregular domains, but its quadratic cost limits its use on high-resolution problems. Efficient latent-attention models such as the Fast Low-rank Attention Routing Engine (FLARE) avoid that cost by routing all N tokens through M << N learned latent queries, but those queries are parameters: once trained, the same learned query templates serve every input. We remove this restriction with FLARE++, a low-rank attention architecture with dynamic token routing. FLARE++ reuses FLARE's own encoder to build its routing queries: learned latent seeds drive one extra encode call that gathers the N input tokens into M input-conditioned queries, and those queries then determine how the same tokens are compressed and redistributed. This preserves FLARE's explicit low-rank factorization and linear O(NM) complexity, and expresses the complete routing operation with standard scaled dot-pro

translated_title: FLARE++：具有动态注意力路由的低秩注意力机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11519v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：全自注意力是不规则域上偏微分方程代理模型的强大令牌混合器，但其二次复杂度限制了其在高分辨率问题中的应用。诸如快速低秩注意力路由引擎（FLARE）之类的高效潜在注意力模型通过将所有N个令牌路由到M << N个学习的潜在查询来避免这种成本，但这些查询是参数：一旦训练完成，相同的学习查询模板服务于每个输入。我们通过FLARE++（一种具有动态令牌路由的低秩注意力架构）消除了这一限制。FLARE++重用FLARE自身的编码器来构建其路由查询：学习到的潜在种子驱动一次额外的编码调用，将N个输入令牌收集到M个输入条件查询中，然后这些查询决定相同令牌如何被压缩和重新分布。这保留了FLARE的显式低秩分解和线性O(NM)复杂度，并用标准缩放点积注意力表达了完整的路由操作。
tldr: FLARE++通过动态输入条件路由取代固定潜在查询，实现了低秩注意力，在保持线性复杂度的同时提升了对输入的自适应性。
en_tdlr: FLARE++ replaces fixed latent queries with dynamic input-conditioned routing in low-rank attention, achieving linear complexity while improving adaptability to inputs.
